title: Norm bound for a coordinate tensor sum
statement: Let $I$ be a finite set and let $a_{ij}\in\mathbb R$ for $i,j\in I$. Define the bilinear form $T\colon\mathbb R^I\times\mathbb R^I\to\mathbb R$ by $T(u,v)=\sum_{i,j\in I}a_{ij}u_jv_i$, and equip $\mathbb R^I$ with its usual supremum norm. Its operator norm satisfies $\|T\|\leq\sum_{i,j\in I}|a_{ij}|$.
replaced: Let $I$ be finite and $a_{ij}\in\mathbb R$. For the bilinear form $T(h,k)=\sum_{i,j}a_{ij}h_jk_i$ on maximum-norm vectors in $\mathbb R^I$, $\|T\|\le\sum_{i,j}|a_{ij}|$.
